files.beforeContent:
name: Wolf Factory Night Shift Wakeup
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 0-6 * * *'
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: wolf-night-shift-bootstrap
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  existing-factory:
    if: github.event.repository.private == false && github.repository == 'insidethemarginmedia-cpu/wolf-factory-home' && github.actor == 'insidethemarginmedia-cpu'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    uses: insidethemarginmedia-cpu/wolf-factory-home/.github/workflows/private-controller-preflight.yml@c6ddef9c2ae03a80fe698fcc5949ceb47adea1a1
    with:
      night_shift: true
    secrets:
      WOLF_FACTORY_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WOLF_FACTORY_REPO_TOKEN }}
      WOLF_FACTORY_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.WOLF_FACTORY_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      GROQ_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GROQ_API_KEY }}
      BOXXKITE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOXXKITE_API_KEY }}

expectedRoutingEffects: Grant the existing caller Actions metadata read
Use the reviewed immutable reusable controller and matching public_runtime_sha
Keep existing cron, concurrency, secret references and bounded economic policy
Keep DBOS/OpenCode qualification and runner-loss diagnostics explicitly manual
operationalBlockers: V1 has no separately approved and published terminal disposition
Existing terminal contract requires trusted durable intent/CAS and authority-verifier ports; the current workflow does not bind those ports
Independent scheduled admission remains process-local and authorizes maxMissions=1; a trusted cross-job handoff and explicit bounded A/B scope are not supplied
Promoting this caller alone still fails closed against V1 identity/source and cannot demonstrate unattended A/B
requiredSeparateApprovals: Exact V1 failure disposition; no replay or V1 lease release/reset
Reviewed operational authority/publisher binding and bounded existing OMEGA A/B scheduled acceptance scope after V1 closure
Exact main caller promotion only after operational blockers are resolved
